verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a local inference server, so throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions continuous batching, chunked prefill, or serving-throughput tuning. GPU auto-detection, distributed worker nodes and horizontal scaling are adjacent scaling features, not the named batching or prefill capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can achieve high serving throughput via continuous batching and chunked prefill
